text:
Ira: heads-up — customers on v1/client-auth are hitting 403s after the new token handshake rolled out. we need a low-friction migration path for tenants that can't rotate quickly.
Samir: can we do a runtime fallback that accepts old tokens for an opt-in tenant window? maybe a toggle per-tenant in the routing layer.
Helen: product prefers a finite opt-in window (30 days) and a telemetry banner. legal wants no permanent backdoors.
Jo: quick idea: add a short-lived compatibility adapter in the gateway that validates old tokens but marks requests with an X-compatness header. then we log and show telemetry to tenant admins.
Ira: yeah that keeps the auth-change localized. tradeoff: increases attack surface and complexity in gateway. need to scope TTL and auditing.
Samir: alternative: client-side shim + lightweight server redirect that returns 307 to an onboarding flow. better security but requires client updates.
Maria: many customers use third-party SDKs we don't control — we need server-side help.
deploy-bot: deploy started by samir-ci for infra/compat-adapter v1 -> canary 10%
Jo: propose hybrid: 1) gateway adapter accepts old token but rewrites requests to include header `X-RW-Compat: token-v1` 2) routed requests go to a compat middleware that emits telemetry and rate-limits to prevent abuse 3) adapter auto-expire after 30d and can be revoked per-tenant.
Ira: sounds reasonable. need to define the header shape and telemetry fields. also add a kill-switch flag on the tenant record.
Samir: example header we discussed: `X-RW-Compat: {"mode":"token-v1","expires":"2025-05-01T00:00:00Z"}` — but please note: gateway should sign the header to avoid downstream spoofing.
Jo: agree on signing. we can reuse the router HMAC key and include `X-RW-Compat-Sig`.
Helen: how do we surface this to customers? proposing: console banner + tenant-level inbox email + API that lists compat status.
Ira: also need a small migration helper lib for popular SDKs with automated token rotation code. should be open-source.
Maria: action items for this thread: 1) Samir: implement adapter prototype + canary (ETA 3d) 2) Jo: spec header format + signing (ETA 2d) 3) Helen: copy + console UX (ETA 5d) 4) Ira: add tenant kill-switch + audit log (ETA 3d) 5) Maria: draft OSS migration helpers list (ETA 7d).
Samir: will add a short health-check endpoint on the adapter: `/compat/health` that returns `{"tenants":<count>,"mode":"accepting"}` so SRE can monitor.
Jo: add a slow-path timer metric when the adapter is active so we can track perf regressions.
Ira: one last thing — we should not log raw tokens anywhere. the adapter must redact tokens and only log token-hash and tenant-id. security team approved that approach earlier.
Helen: ok let's sync tomorrow's standup for any blockers. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary completed: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (no regressions observed)
Samir: rolling revocation playbook into runbook now.
Maria: I'll start the migration helper repo and ping here when the first client example is up.
Ira: closing the thread for now. we'll file a short RFC with flow diagrams and link it to the deprecation calendar.
